provenance.source: Toyota Motor Corporation, Toyota Premieres New Supra at Detroit Auto Show (news release, 14 January 2019)
provenance.notes: Presentation of the fifth Supra, sold as the GR Supra outside Japan.

provenance.source: Toyota Motor Corporation, Toyota Rolls Out New Supra (news release, 17 May 2019)
provenance.notes: Start of the generation: on sale in Japan from 17 May 2019; the first global model of the GR sports car series.

provenance.source: Toyota Motor Corporation, Supra main specifications (Japan, April 2020)
Toyota Motor Corporation, Supra main specifications (Japan, March 2025)
provenance.notes: Type designations 3BA-DB06, 3BA-DB26 and 3BA-DB86 after the updates: the DB family continues, with no new generation name.

provenance.source: Toyota Motor Corporation, TGR Launches Partially Upgraded Supra RZ Grade and Special-edition Supra A90 Final Edition in Japan (news release, March 2025)
provenance.notes: Toyota names this generation A90 (A90 Final Edition). The partial upgrades of the generation (2020, 2022, 2025) stay in it.

provenance.source: Carscoops, Toyota Just Put A Date On The Supra's Goodbye (October 2025)
provenance.notes: Reports Toyota's announcement on its Japanese website that production of the Supra ends in March 2026: the last year of the generation is 2026.
